D: Agent J travels back to 1969 to save a young Agent K from an alien assassin.
P: Serve dessert when young K and J stop for pie at the diner.
S: Mr Wu's pork and prawn dumplings
Steamed pork, prawn and ginger dumplings
Pork and prawn dumplings steamed in bamboo baskets for 8 minutes, with soy and chilli oil.
Agent K's shrimp and bok choy
green prawns and baby bok choy wok-tossed with garlic, ginger and oyster sauce

Prawns and baby bok choy stir-fried hot with garlic, ginger and oyster sauce, a small plate to share. Peel and devein 250g green prawns, leaving the tails on, and toss with 1 tsp cornflour. Heat 1 tbsp vegetable oil in a wok until smoking and fry the prawns for 2 minutes until just pink, then lift out. Add 2 sliced garlic cloves and a little ginger cut into matchsticks and fry for 30 seconds. Add 2 halved baby bok choy and a splash of water and toss for 2 minutes. Return the prawns with 1 tbsp oyster sauce and a splash of soy, toss and serve.
Puffed prawn crackers straight from the wok, still crackling hot

Dried prawn crackers dropped into hot oil until they puff up white and crisp, salted and served warm. Heat 5cm vegetable oil to 180C and fry 100g dried prawn crackers a few at a time for 5 seconds until puffed, lift out, drain and salt.
M: Squid tossed in cornflour and fried crisp with chilli, garlic and spring onion

Squid tossed in seasoned cornflour and fried crisp, then wok-tossed with chilli, garlic and spring onion. Cut 500g cleaned squid tubes into strips and score lightly. Toss in 60g cornflour mixed with 1 tsp each of salt, white pepper and Sichuan pepper. Deep-fry at 180C in batches for 90 seconds until crisp. Wok-toss with 2 sliced garlic cloves, 1 sliced red chilli and 2 spring onions for 30 seconds and serve with lemon.
Steamed snapper with ginger, spring onion and sizzling soy

Snapper fillets steamed over ginger and spring onion, then finished with sizzling oil and soy, served with jasmine rice. Cook 300g jasmine rice. Lay 4 skin-on snapper fillets on a heatproof plate over a thumb of ginger cut into matchsticks, and steam over a wok of simmering water for 8 to 10 minutes until just flaking. Scatter with 4 finely shredded spring onions and more ginger. Heat 3 tbsp vegetable oil until smoking and pour over the fish so it sizzles, then spoon over 3 tbsp light soy sauce mixed with 1 tsp sugar and 2 tbsp of the steaming water. Serve with the rice.
W: Cinnamon green apples under a lattice crust
Apples cooked with butter, sugar and cinnamon, baked in shortcrust with a lattice top at 190C for 45 minutes, served warm with ice cream.
K: Vodka, coffee liqueur and strong espresso shaken ice cold

Vodka, fresh espresso and coffee liqueur shaken hard with ice until a thick crema forms, strained into chilled glasses with three coffee beans. Chill 4 martini glasses in the freezer. Make 4 shots of strong espresso or 200ml very strong coffee and cool for 5 minutes. Shake 2 drinks at a time: 90ml vodka, 60ml coffee liqueur, 100ml espresso and 1 tbsp sugar syrup with a big scoop of ice, shaking hard for 20 seconds. Strain into the glasses and float 3 coffee beans on the foam. For non-drinkers, shake espresso with syrup and milk over ice.

Crumble the tofu and mix with the mushrooms, ginger and soy.

veg.n: Agent K's shrimp and bok choy (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Press and cube the tofu up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; wok-toss on the night

steps.text: Toss the tofu in the cornflour and fry in most of the oil until crisp on all sides, then lift out.
Add the rest of the oil and fry the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds, add the bok choy and a splash of water and toss for 2 minutes.
Return the tofu with the mushroom oyster sauce and soy, toss and serve.

Lay the snapper on a heatproof plate over half the ginger and steam over a wok of simmering water until just flaking.
Scatter with the spring onions and the rest of the ginger. Mix the soy with the sugar and 2 tbsp of the steaming water.
Heat the oil until smoking, pour it over the fish so it sizzles, spoon over the soy and serve with the rice.

steps.text: Cook the jasmine rice.
Lay the tofu on a heatproof plate over half the ginger and steam over simmering water until hot through.
Scatter with the spring onions and the rest of the ginger. Mix the soy with the sugar and 2 tbsp water.
Heat the oil until smoking, pour it over the tofu so it sizzles, spoon over the soy and serve with the rice.

dishes.make_ahead: Bake up to 1 day ahead and keep covered; rewarm in a 160C oven for 15 minutes and serve with ice cream

Cook with butter, sugar and cinnamon until just soft.
Cool the filling for 20 minutes.
Line a pie dish with pastry, fill and weave a lattice on top.
Bake at 190C.
Serve warm with ice cream.

Make strong espresso or coffee.

Stir the vanilla into the sugar syrup.
Shake two drinks at a time with cold brew, vanilla syrup and plenty of ice, very hard for 30 seconds to build the foam.
Strain into the glasses and float three coffee beans on the foam. Repeat.
